# x402 E.164 Phone Normalizer

> Normalize phone numbers to E.164. Strip formatting, detect common country codes, validate structure. Pure rule-based, no heavy libs. No accounts. Pay per call with x402 (USDC on Base).

## Paid Endpoint

- POST /api/normalize
  - Input: `{ "phone": "string", "defaultCountry"?: "US"|"GB"|... }`
  - Output: `{ "success": true, "result": { e164, country, national, valid }, "meta": {...} }`
  - Price: ~0.006 USDC

## Free Discovery

- GET /catalog
- GET / (service card)

## Why agents use it

- Canonical form for contact deduplication and SMS gateways
- Lightweight rules covering major countries
- Token-cheap, deterministic
